# CultStudio

> CultStudio is an independent creative technology studio offering web development, software, practical AI automation, digital growth, and creative design.

Examples on the website are clearly labelled concept explorations. Contact the studio through the project enquiry form to discuss a real project.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Services, concept explorations, process, FAQs, and project enquiry form.
- [Privacy notice](/privacy.html): Information about enquiry submissions and Formspree processing.
